Note the click sets a session flag that survives the rerun the dialog needs, because a component value only reaches Python at the start of a run; the dialog clears the flag on close.

items.title: Virtual lab instruments driven by the real model
items.why: GROUP B. DONE. sabes/instruments/ holds power meter, beam profiler, wavemeter, photodiode, oscilloscope and spectrum analyser. Optical heads take whatever sabes.layout.beam_at resolves at a clicked point; the oscilloscope and analyser take a PhotocurrentSignal from a photodiode, so they cannot be pointed at a bare beam -- the right restriction rather than an inconvenience. A test asserts the package imports neither the layout nor streamlit nor matplotlib, so it stays liftable. The wavemeter is the demonstration piece: dropped either side of the etalon chain it shows carrier:wanted going 34.96 -> 4.18 -> 0.0596 percent, which is the whole reason the seed path has three filters. The power meter deliberately reports total AND wanted and warns when they differ, because a real power meter cannot tell them apart -- which is exactly why purity needs its own instrument. The profiler reports the 1/e^2 radius WHERE IT IS, not the waist; the two differ by a factor of two over a metre of table. One API fault was caught and fixed: the analyser took a total_power_w override for the shot-noise level (a balanced measurement sees both arms while the head is one diode) but read clearance off the signal, so the two could disagree silently. Clearance is now derived from the same power. Verified in the app: clicking the seed line after etalon 1 and switching instruments gives a power meter warning at 82.4 percent purity, a wavemeter reading 4.177 percent carrier, and an analyser with its SYNTHESISED badge reporting where the explicitly nonphysical gain-diagnostic overlay sits relative to the amplifier floor.

items.title: Stop presenting mean-field gain scores as measured or predicted squeezing
items.problem: SABES now exposes the gain-referred scalar under a MEAN_FIELD_DIAGNOSTIC claim gate and labels the spectrum-analyser view as an electronics-headroom overlay, but compatibility aliases remain and a true physical_squeezing value still requires M_q(Omega_SA), diffusion, covariance, and same-condition SQL calibration. SYNTHESISED provenance alone is not physical validity.
evidence: The production result exposes T_field, Q, T_can, photon-flux gap, commutator defect, and a structured gate with QUANTITATIVE_GAIN_UNSUPPORTED and PHYSICAL_SQUEEZING_UNAVAILABLE badges.

SpectrumAnalyzer accepts only the scalar gain diagnostic as an explicitly nonphysical detector-headroom overlay and no longer claims measured-shape reproduction; no frequency-dependent source covariance is available.
The existing Spectrum tab is a two-photon-detuning parameter scan, not a noise spectrum versus RF analysis frequency.
acceptance_criteria: The SABES result has separate nullable physical_squeezing and historical_gain_only_diagnostic fields. Noncanonical defaults return physical_squeezing unavailable rather than a signed dB prediction.

Header, hero cards, help text, optimizer, loss-limited floor, and electronic-margin language do not call a gain-only score squeezing or below shot noise; G_p, G_c, photon-flux gap, commutator status, and assumptions replace it.
Reading provenance (computed or synthesised) is independent of validity/evidence class (mean_field_diagnostic, model_prediction, calibrated_reproduction, or measured), and both are visible.

The two-photon-detuning scan is named mean-field gain/diagnostic versus detuning. A noise spectrum versus analysis frequency is created only from a frequency grid plus full covariance or PSD and same-condition SQL calibration.
SpectrumAnalyzer no longer accepts a scalar S_dB as a physical source spectrum, and all claims that a flat trace reproduces measured shape are removed.
Post-cell loss and QE are removed from the atomic solve/cache key. Observed pump_leakage_dbm is routed to the analyser when that measured detector path is used.
Tests cover the passive (0.2,0.1) case, current noncanonical defaults, typed frequency-axis separation, and absence of a physical squeezing value without covariance.

items.title: Track calibration applicability, uncertainty, dependencies, and holdout role
items.problem: The calibration file now contains 85 coefficients, 57 of which the current code classifies as unverified, so the old 25-of-42 checklist count is stale. More importantly, datasheet, paper, fitted, lab, and nominal tags do not record exact-part applicability, uncertainty, conditions, fit-versus-holdout role, or which outputs depend on a coefficient. A fitted value and a paper number can therefore look verified even when reused outside their evidence domain.
evidence: VERIFIED_PROVENANCE currently treats fitted, datasheet, and paper as a single boolean class although the module prose says only fitted means verified.
The stock-PDB450A NEP is stored as datasheet/verified even though the installed S3883 photodiodes change the amplifier noise gain.
cell_length_mm, post_cell_loss_pct, and pump_seed_angle_deg duplicate or do not feed the current SABES Python path, creating multiple nominal sources of truth.
acceptance_criteria: Each coefficient schema includes value, unit, evidence class, source URI or immutable reference, exact part/setup applicability, conditions, uncertainty and distribution, acquisition or review date, owner, and calibration-versus-holdout role. Missing knowledge is recorded as explicit unknown or not_applicable and is never inferred to make the schema look complete.

Fitted records name the raw dataset, objective, fitted companions, covariance or identifiability result, and held-out checks; fitted=1 or a paper value is not automatically equivalent to an independent measurement.
Downstream dependency metadata lets every output list the coefficients and unsupported assumptions that affect it, with uncertainty propagated where the model supports it.
Unverified counts are derived at runtime by evidence class and applicability rather than copied into prose; modified-component datasheets cannot receive a measured badge.

An unknown required field makes dependent physical claims UNSUPPORTED and keeps optional correction factors at one or disabled until independent evidence arrives; completing the schema does not require inventing measurements.
Dead or duplicate cell_length_mm, post_cell_loss_pct, and pump_seed_angle_deg entries are removed or wired to one authoritative source with a regression proving no conflicting value remains.
Hand edits remain session-local and cannot be persisted as calibrated without a source, uncertainty, and explicit promotion action.

items.title: Acquire fit/holdout measurements for the SABES optical and detector chain
items.problem: The trust schema can prevent overclaiming, but it cannot replace the missing lab evidence. EOM efficiency parameters are jointly back-solved, the TA transfer is weakly constrained, etalon leakage is fitted to one number, the detector NEP belongs to stock rather than installed diodes, and many table transmissions and distances remain nominal.
blocked_on: Sideband ratio versus RF power and independent insertion-loss measurements for the installed EOM path.
TA output versus current at multiple known seed powers, including threshold, linear, and saturation regions.
Per-stage etalon transmission scans and carrier/sideband leakage with frequency and angular alignment metadata.
Installed-S3883 balanced-detector dark noise, transfer response, responsivity, saturation, and common-mode rejection measurements.
Per-arm optical powers/transmissions and geometry records with uncertainties, plus named fit and held-out operating points.
acceptance_criteria: Archive raw data or stable provenance links with units, timestamps, hardware configuration, immutable hashes, and uncertainty budgets.
Predeclare fit and held-out sweeps so EOM V_pi/insertion loss, TA slope/saturation, etalon leakage, detector noise, and path losses are not validated on their calibration points.
Jointly fit entangled coefficients with covariance or profile-likelihood diagnostics; non-identifiable parameters remain grouped rather than reported separately.
Validate optical powers, carrier-to-sideband ratios, detector clearance, and gain transfer on held-out settings before changing their evidence class.
Outputs remain PREDICTED, CALIBRATED-ONLY, or UNSUPPORTED wherever a required held-out measurement is absent or fails.

items.title: Calibrate frequency-dependent balanced detection and the matching SQL
items.problem: A physical SABES noise trace needs per-arm complex detector transfer, electronic noise, weighting, common-mode leakage, and an SQL measured with the same detected powers and analyser settings. The current scalar transmission, NEP, bandwidth, and flat source score cannot represent those quantities or the reported low-frequency, 2 MHz, and bandwidth features.
blocked_on: Measured complex H_p(Omega) and H_c(Omega), per-arm optical powers and efficiencies, and detector electronic-noise spectrum S_el(Omega).
Measured or predeclared balance weight w(Omega), CMRR/crosstalk, pump leakage and RIN, and any cable or analyser transfer.
Shot-noise reference traces using the same powers, RBW, VBW, averaging, impedance, detector gain, and dark-noise included/subtracted convention.
A full model or measured source covariance/PSD on the same analysis-frequency grid.
acceptance_criteria: Detector transfer, source covariance or PSD, electronic noise, and SQL share one typed analysis-frequency grid and explicit one-sided/two-sided plus angular/cyclic-frequency conventions.
The weighted intensity-difference spectrum uses the full covariance with H_p, H_c, and w; optimal weighting is covariance-dependent and never inferred from DC powers alone.
The SQL uses the identical detected powers, filters, RBW/VBW, averaging, impedance, and dark-noise convention as the signal trace, with uncertainty propagated.
Cell absorption and atomic noise are not applied again after propagation; only measured post-cell loss, detector QE, and electronics enter this layer once.
Observed pump leakage and RIN are passed end to end into the analyser, and CMRR/crosstalk tests reproduce injected common-mode and leakage fixtures.
A calibration subset and held-out frequency/settings subset are predeclared; missing data produce unavailable bands rather than interpolation presented as measurement.

items.title: Validate the end-to-end squeezing spectrum on held-out measurements
items.problem: Microscopic drift/diffusion invariants and detector calibration are necessary but do not establish that their composition predicts the experiment. The reconstruction separately leaves quantitative gain, the approximately 3.5 MHz bandwidth, and the full measured squeezing spectrum unvalidated; without a final gate, internal PASS results could again be mistaken for experimental validation.
blocked_on: Raw balanced-detector spectra spanning at least 0.1-4 MHz for calibration and held-out detuning, temperature, pump/seed power, and geometry settings.
Matched raw probe/conjugate powers or gains, detector transfer/calibration traces, RBW/VBW/averaging, dark-noise convention, pump leakage/RIN, and uncertainty for every spectrum.
A predeclared split that does not reuse the held-out approximately 150 kHz level, 2 MHz technical-noise feature, bandwidth edge, or maximum squeezing to tune the model.
acceptance_criteria: Freeze microscopic, phenomenological, and detector parameters on the calibration subset before evaluating held-out spectra.
On identical operating conditions and SQL convention, compare G_p, G_c, and the full S_minus(Omega) curve with uncertainty-aware residuals rather than only a maximum dB value.

Report predeclared metrics for the low-frequency or approximately 150 kHz region, the approximately 2 MHz technical-noise feature, the approximately 3.5 MHz roll-off or bandwidth, and maximum squeezing; distinguish atomic covariance from measured laser/electronic/detector contributions.
Frequency grid, model truncation, velocity integration, covariance propagation, detector transfer, and SQL calibration each retain their own status in the final result.
A failed or missing held-out comparison leaves the result PHYSICAL-MODEL PREDICTION, EXTERNALLY UNVALIDATED; no internal invariant or calibration-point fit upgrades it.

items.title: Remove the completed SABES canvas development spike
items.problem: The optical-table view has landed, but the temporary ?app=sabes&dev=canvas route, spike module, session keys, and spike-specific tests remain even though the completed checklist record says to delete them after integration.
items.why: DONE. Removed the temporary ?app=sabes&dev=canvas route and its now-unused query-parameter callback, deleted the spike module and its private session-state keys, and removed only the two spike-specific tests. The production static canvas component and its packaging, protocol, repeat-click sequence, coordinate-scaling, JSON transport, and optical-table rendering tests remain in place.
acceptance_criteria: Remove the development route, spike module, spike-only session state, and tests that assert the temporary route remains reachable.
Keep production canvas component round-trip, resize, repeat-click, and coordinate-scaling coverage in the real optical-table tests.
Normal GABES/SABES URLs and production canvas behavior remain unchanged.

items.title: Return the dispersive partner of the OD/SAS absorption profile
items.problem: The OD/SAS spectrum is assembled from unit-area absorption Lorentzians only, so the real part of the susceptibility is never formed. Refractive index, accumulated phase, polarization rotation, and group index are unavailable on the one scheme that owns the validated hyperfine absolute scale, and any later polarimetric or Faraday/Voigt readout would have no dispersive input to propagate.
evidence: schemes/sas.py builds each hyperfine component as a unit-area Lorentzian (hwhm/pi)/(arg^2 + hwhm^2) and sums absorption only; observables.py exposes transmission and optical_density from alpha, while observables.group_index has no OD/SAS caller.

ElecSus obtains absorption and dispersion from a single Faddeeva evaluation of one complex line profile and reuses the real part for refractive index, rotation angle, and group index (libs/spectra.py, add_voigt).
items.why: DONE. Each hyperfine component now contributes one complex profile, chi_t = (A_t/k)*i/(pi*(Gamma_eff/2 - i*delta_t)): the imaginary part is the unit-area lineshape that already built alpha and the real part is its Kramers-Kronig partner, both weighted by the same velocity-resolved population difference and the same Doppler quadrature, so a pumped spectrum reports the saturated medium's dispersion. The generic path takes both quadratures from the one weak-probe susceptibility it already solved. compute() returns chi_real_unit and k_vec; observables scales it with the same line-strength factor as alpha and adds a Dispersion view (n - 1 in ppm, ASCII axis labels) plus a Peak phase shift metric. observables.refractive_index and observables.single_pass_phase now hold the dilute-vapor convention that group_index also calls. alpha is bit-for-bit unchanged on seven species/line/pump/coating cases checked against the previous revision, so the AutoOD anchor is untouched. Both quadratures agree with an independent scipy Faddeeva Voigt reference to 3e-4 at 25 C and 90 C, and the homogeneous-limit sign is pinned by a two-level OBE fixture (Re chi / Im chi = -delta/hwhm to 2e-8, n > 1 below resonance). No group-index readout is exposed.
acceptance_criteria: Absorption and dispersion for each hyperfine component come from one complex lineshape evaluation with a documented sign and frequency convention, not from two independently normalized profiles.

The dispersive component carries the same velocity-resolved population difference and the same Doppler quadrature as the absorption; a weak-probe dispersion is never paired with a saturated absorption spectrum.
A Kramers-Kronig or analytic-Voigt fixture checks the returned real part against an independent reference in both the homogeneous limit and a Doppler-broadened case.
The pump-off Rb-85 D1 AutoOD absolute anchor remains within its documented 0.1% tolerance.
Any refractive-index or group-index readout reuses observables.group_index instead of a scheme-local re-implementation, and states whether it is a phase or a group quantity.
out_of_scope: Polarization propagation and Stokes observables, which belong to od-sas-weak-probe-magneto-optical-reference-mode.
Changes to FWM susceptibility conventions or frozen FWM baselines.

items.title: Separate the OD/SAS density temperature from the Doppler-width temperature
items.problem: One temp_c sets vapor density, Doppler width, and every temperature-dependent collisional rate in OD/SAS. Real cells run a cold spot below the body temperature, so a single knob forces any comparison with data to trade absolute absorption against measured width, and a heated-window or cold-finger cell cannot be represented at all.
evidence: schemes/sas.py derives the number density from species.number_density(iso, T) and the Doppler sigma_v from the same T.
The Rydberg scheme already separates heater setpoint, effective vapor temperature, and cold-spot temperature, so the convention exists in the repository but not in OD/SAS.
ElecSus exposes an independent DoppTemp with a Constrain flag that ties it to the density temperature by default (libs/spectra.py, p_dict_defaults and calc_chi).
items.why: DONE. temp_c is now explicitly the vapor-density temperature (number density and density-dependent self-broadening) and an Advanced 'Tie Doppler width to cell temperature' checkbox releases a separate doppler_temp_c that drives the thermal velocity distribution only (Doppler FWHM and velocity classes). The tie is on by default and a params dict predating both knobs stays tied, so default, explicitly tied, released-but-equal and legacy calls are bit-for-bit identical to the previous revision and the AutoOD anchor is unchanged. A released fixture moves the two independently: Doppler FWHM scales as sqrt(T_Doppler) with the integrated absorption fixed to 2e-3, while the density temperature alone moves the integral with the width fixed. Raw results carry density_temp_c, doppler_temp_c and doppler_temp_tied; the plot title, the Gaussian Doppler FWHM help and a Doppler-width temperature metric (shown only when released) name which temperature each quantity came from, and the About text records that buffer-gas broadening is pressure-only and the transit rate is a separate knob.
acceptance_criteria: The scheme accepts a separate Doppler temperature behind an explicit constrain toggle whose default reproduces current results bit-for-bit.

Output and documentation state which temperature enters number density, Doppler width, self-broadening, buffer-gas rates, and transit relaxation; the collisional-rate assignment follows collisional-coefficient-provenance-and-pressure-shift instead of being decided a second time here.
The pump-off Rb-85 D1 AutoOD anchor is unchanged in the constrained default.
An unconstrained fixture with the density temperature above the Doppler temperature moves peak OD and Doppler FWHM independently and in the expected directions.
Naming distinguishes the two temperatures everywhere they appear, so a reported temperature cannot be read as both.

items.title: Extract cell parameters from an imported OD spectrum instead of aligning it by eye
items.problem: The CSV comparison panel can only scale and shift an imported trace visually and states that it does not fit spectral features, so GABES cannot return a temperature, cell length, extra homogeneous width, or frequency offset with an uncertainty from measured data. Every experimental comparison ends as a qualitative overlay, and no path in the repository produces uncertainty-aware residuals.
evidence: streamlit_app.py offers X scale, X shift, reverse, and invert controls whose help text says the action does not fit spectral features.
No optimizer call exists anywhere in the repository: curve_fit, least_squares, lmfit, and differential_evolution are absent.

The imported trace already carries what a weighted fit needs (calibration mode, denoising diagnostics, preserved sweep branches) from experimental-csv-calibration-and-sweep-direction, so the missing layer is the fit itself.

ElecSus builds its published use case on this capability: fit_data takes per-parameter vary booleans and bounds, offers Marquardt-Levenberg, differential evolution, random restart, and simulated annealing, and always finishes with a local Levenberg-Marquardt pass to obtain parameter uncertainties alongside an RMS and a fit report (elecsus_methods.py, libs/MLFittingRoutine.py, tests/fitting_tests.py).
acceptance_criteria: Fitting targets the pump-off weak-probe OD path by default; a pumped SAS fit is offered only with a stated runtime budget and evaluation-count bound, because every evaluation re-solves the OBE pump table.
The free-parameter set is declared and bounded, each entry has a stated physical meaning and unit, and parameters that only absorb lab distortions are refused rather than silently fitted.
The model is evaluated on the experimental detuning axis; any resampling or interpolation used to form residuals is recorded in the result.

Residuals are weighted by a per-point uncertainty derived from the imported trace, for example a binned standard deviation, and the report includes RMS, parameter uncertainties from a covariance evaluation at the optimum, and a residual distribution.

A correlation or conditioning report flags degenerate combinations, in particular density temperature against cell length against the line-strength factor, instead of returning an independent confident value for each.
Global search and local refinement are distinguished, and quoted uncertainties never come from the global stage alone.
A synthetic round-trip fixture recovers known parameters from a noiseless generated spectrum within a stated tolerance, and a noisy fixture recovers them within the reported uncertainties.
Fit and held-out detuning ranges are predeclared whenever a fit result is used to claim model validity; a fit that uses every point for both calibration and validation is labelled calibration only.
Manual alignment remains available and no fit runs without an explicit user action.
out_of_scope: Fitting isotope fractions, magnetic field, or polarization parameters before the corresponding model paths exist.
Reporting a fitted line-strength factor as a physical calibration; it stays a residual knob.

items.title: Support non-natural isotope fractions and decide on further alkali elements
items.problem: Species selection is a fixed menu: natural Rb uses the tabulated abundance split and each single-isotope entry assumes a pure cell, so an enriched or depleted cell cannot be represented even though its spectrum differs from a natural one only by two weights. Adding K or Na would additionally require hyperfine, dipole, vapor-pressure, saturation, and collisional data that no current item covers.
evidence: species.py fixes the isotope weights in SPECIES, and number_density implements a Rb and a Cs vapor-pressure fit only.

ElecSus treats rb85frac, K40frac, and K41frac as ordinary parameters that may also be varied during a fit, and covers Na, K-39/40/41, Rb-85/87, and Cs from one Alcock-based vapor-pressure module (libs/numberDensityEqs.py, libs/AtomConstants.py).
decision_required: Whether enriched or depleted cells are actually in use, or whether the natural and pure-isotope menu is sufficient for current work.

Which additional elements, if any, belong in GABES scope; each new element needs sourced hyperfine constants, line data, a vapor-pressure fit with a validity range, and saturation and collisional entries.
acceptance_criteria: Isotope weights become an explicit normalized input whose default reproduces the current natural-abundance and pure-isotope spectra exactly.
Elemental density and per-isotope density stay distinguishable in code and output, and the Rb-85 D1 AutoOD anchor is unchanged at natural abundance.

A new element is offered only when its hyperfine, dipole, vapor-pressure, saturation, and collisional data are sourced with validity ranges; otherwise it is not listed rather than reusing another element's constants.
Fitted isotope fractions, if ever allowed, are constrained to sum to one and carry the identifiability statement required by od-sas-experimental-spectrum-fitting.

items.title: Add a weak-probe Zeeman and polarization reference path for absorption spectra
items.problem: The OD/SAS manifold is hyperfine-lumped and its readout is a scalar absorption coefficient, so an applied magnetic field, an input polarization, and every polarimetric observable (Faraday rotation, dichroism, Stokes parameters) lie outside the model. Solving the full m_F manifold with the OBE for every velocity class and scan point costs far more than the weak-probe limit these measurements need.
evidence: schemes/sas.py declares no magnetic-field or polarization parameter and returns transmission and optical density from a scalar alpha.

The Zeeman machinery in zeeman.py serves the magneto scheme for a single 87Rb D1 F -> F' pair with a longitudinal field, so it does not cover a Doppler-broadened multi-line D1/D2 spectrum at arbitrary field magnitude and direction.
paraffin-coated-cell-extensions already records that the hyperfine-lumped OD/SAS manifold cannot carry Zeeman polarization moments.

ElecSus reaches the same physics in the weak-probe limit by diagonalizing the hyperfine plus Zeeman Hamiltonian in the uncoupled basis per isotope, which stays valid from the anomalous Zeeman regime through hyperfine Paschen-Back, then propagates the field through the dielectric-tensor normal modes and applies Jones matrices to obtain S0-S3 and the linear and circular intensities (libs/EigenSystem.py, libs/solve_dielectric.py, libs/spectra.py, libs/JonesMatrices.py).
items.activation_trigger: Choose the target measurement (field magnitude and geometry, isotope and line, input polarization, detected Stokes component), provide a calibration spectrum and a held-out measured spectrum with conditions and uncertainties, and set a runtime budget.
acceptance_criteria: The weak-probe path is a separately labelled mode that claims no pump saturation, hole burning, or hyperfine pumping, and the pumped OBE path never inherits its Zeeman output.
Level energies and transition strengths come from one diagonalization valid at arbitrary field, with the low-field and Paschen-Back limits checked against independent references.
The ground-state population assumption is stated, degeneracy-weighted or Boltzmann, and is testable in a case with large ground-state splitting.

Polarization propagation uses the medium's normal modes rather than assuming a Faraday geometry; Voigt and intermediate angles are either supported with a convergence statement or refused with an explicit unsupported status.
Transmission, rotation, and ellipticity are all derived from one output field vector, so they cannot disagree with each other.
At zero field with linear input polarization, the mode reproduces the existing pump-off absorption spectrum within a documented tolerance.
out_of_scope: Field or temperature gradients, which belong to od-sas-segmented-cell-propagation.

items.title: Propagate the beams through a segmented cell instead of one uniform slab
items.problem: The cell is treated as a single uniform slab: transmission is exp(-alpha L) with one alpha, and the pump Rabi frequency is computed once from the input power and never attenuates along z. A real saturated-absorption cell depletes its own pump with depth and can hold temperature or field gradients, so pumped features are systematically optimistic at high optical depth and a graded cell cannot be represented.
evidence: observables.transmission applies exp(-alpha L) with one scheme-level alpha, and schemes/sas.py computes the pump Rabi frequency once from pump_power_mw and the waist.

ElecSus supports non-uniform cells by slicing the cell and feeding each slice's output field into the next (libs/spectra.py, get_Efield), and uses that path to fit a measured magnetic-field profile (tests/fit_fieldgradient.py).
acceptance_criteria: Segment count is an explicit convergence parameter with a documented convergence test showing the reported observables are stable to a stated tolerance.
With one segment and no gradient the result is bit-for-bit identical to the current uniform path, and the pump-off Rb-85 D1 AutoOD anchor stays within its documented tolerance at any segment count.
Pump attenuation, when enabled, uses the same absorption model as the probe, and its effect on Lamb-dip depth and sub-Doppler contrast is reported rather than absorbed into the line-strength factor.
Temperature and magnetic-field profiles are declared per-segment inputs with sources; a profile inferred from data is treated as a nuisance profile with its own identifiability statement.
Runtime scales linearly with segment count, the default keeps the interactive two-tier cache usable, and the default segment count is stated in the output.
out_of_scope: Transverse beam profiles, diffraction, and radial intensity averaging.
Counter-propagating pump depletion feedback beyond the declared single-pass model unless a convergence criterion is given.

items.title: Export plotted arrays, parameters, and provenance from the app
items.problem: The app renders figures, metrics, and tables but offers no download. The plotted arrays, the parameter set that produced them, and the code revision cannot leave the session, so a figure used in a report cannot be regenerated, diffed, or audited later. Scheme results are also reachable only as figures, metrics, and tables, with no named-array access for scripted reuse.
evidence: No download control exists in streamlit_app.py or sabes_page.py; savefig is used only to build the in-app figure carousel.
The Rydberg CSV workflow already treats provenance as a requirement, with a SHA-256 source manifest and status-tagged JSON output, so the interactive app is the remaining gap.

ElecSus exports CSV data and figures and saves and reloads parameter configurations from its GUI, and its library entry point returns named arrays selected by an outputs list (elecsus_methods.calculate, libs/spectra.output_list).
items.why: IN PROGRESS. Commit 8f97f05 adds a JSON result bundle, individual and ZIP CSV curve downloads, full parameters and defaults, cache/default/readout versions, the Git revision, and experimental-overlay fingerprint, calibration, alignment, trace, statistics, and warnings. Named scheme result arrays shared by scripts and the app, a round-trip reproduction test, and export coverage for lazily rendered extra views remain.
acceptance_criteria: Every plotted curve can be downloaded as data whose column names and units match the axis labels and the readout metrics.
The export carries the full parameter set including advanced knobs, the scheme name, its cache and defaults versions, and a code revision identifier.
Re-running with an exported parameter set reproduces the exported arrays within a stated tolerance, covered by a test.
Schemes expose their result arrays by name so a script and the app read the same values; the export path never re-derives a quantity independently.
An experimental-CSV overlay is exported together with its calibration mode, alignment transform, and any warnings, never as anonymous numbers.
out_of_scope: A general session save and restore or project file format.

_ultra_performance_review.implemented: Guarded Hermitian-basis finite-Floquet reduction: exact coefficient identities and induction give Q_-h=R_h*, eliminating the negative chain and making the zero block real. Same N_F, velocity/detuning grids and full adjacent-order audit; general two-chain fallback retained.
_ultra_performance_review.activation_trigger: A separately declared accuracy or scan-grid change, with domain-wide error evidence and unchanged physical input semantics, is needed before replacing the existing numerical defaults.
parked_candidates: Composite/nonuniform velocity quadrature: require node, cutoff and resonance-panel convergence over the requested domain; raw 128/256 and 5/6-sigma diagnostics do not certify it.
Commensurate detuning-grid reuse: require an explicitly declared new scan grid; do not silently shift requested detunings.
Cubic operating-point readout: require separate interpolation and overshoot checks.
_ultra_performance_review.not_equivalent: A 10-percent sampled order audit is not a full-scan certificate; lowering N_F changes the finite-boundary problem; the two finite-drive seed configurations cannot be merged by the harmonic conjugation identity. These are not exact speed patches.

grand_challenges.title: GABES Grand Challenge
grand_challenges.subtitle: Hot-vapor FWM의 parameter-free microscopic squeezing theory
grand_challenges.area: GABES seeded ⁸⁵Rb D1 double-Λ + microscopic quantum noise + propagation + experimental validation
grand_challenges.registry_role: 일반 items와 구분한 최상급 장기 연구 과제. 기존 세부 과제를 연결하는 상위 연구 명세이며, 기존 항목의 상태나 완료 범위를 바꾸지 않는다. 이 영역의 엄격한 no-fit 완료 기준은 기존 exploratory gain fit이나 conditional Gaussian model의 허용 범위보다 강하다.
grand_challenges.agent_brief: 최고 수준의 AI 에이전트가 장시간의 수학적 유도, 독립 구현, 수치 실험과 반례 탐색을 투자할 만한 연구 문제로 다룬다. 단기 UI 개선이나 기존 gain 곡선 재현으로 축소하지 않는다. 각 단계의 유도·반례·실패 원인·재현 명령을 남겨 여러 연구 세션에서 이어갈 수 있게 한다.
grand_challenges.resource_policy: 고정 토큰 예산이나 자동 실행 일정은 이 등록에서 설정하지 않는다. 모델 이름, 다른 수학 문제를 풀었다는 전언, 투입 토큰 수는 본 과제의 해결 가능성이나 물리적 정당성의 증거가 아니다. 완료 여부는 아래 검증 관문으로 판단한다.
grand_challenges.objective: 실험적으로 독립 측정 가능한 원자·광학 파라미터만을 입력으로 받아, hot ⁸⁵Rb D1 double-Λ FWM의 probe/conjugate gain과 전체 intensity-difference squeezing spectrum S₋(Ω)을 절대값으로 동시에 예측하는 microscopic quantum theory를 구축하라. Phenomenological squeezing efficiency, 임의 excess-noise coefficient, 사후 fitted loss로 결과를 맞추지 않는다.
grand_challenges.problem: 현재 저장소는 finite-seed mean-field 계산과 pump-only/2D Doppler reference를 제공하지만 pumped atomic reservoirs에서 유도한 microscopic diffusion과 실험적으로 검증된 절대 squeezing spectrum은 제공하지 않는다. 비평형 원자 잡음, 공간 전파와 실제 검출을 동일한 정규화·입력·오차 예산으로 닫는 것이 핵심이다.
integrated_physics: Hot-vapor Maxwell velocity distribution과 Doppler broadening
Non-collinear pump/seed/conjugate geometry와 vector phase matching
Full D1 hyperfine/Zeeman structure, polarization과 magnetic field
Strong pump saturation과 선언한 seed 세기에서의 pumped atomic state
Distributed absorption과 그에 동반하는 reservoir noise
Spontaneous-emission Langevin noise, transit/reset 및 검증된 collision channels
Transverse modes, collection/filter transfer와 mode covariance
독립 RF analysis frequency Ω에서의 양·음 sideband 응답
독립 측정한 검출 효율·전달함수·SQL로 환산한 absolute experimental squeezing spectrum

no_fit_contract.meaning: Parameter-free는 물리적 입력이 없다는 뜻이 아니라 목표 FWM gain 또는 squeezing 데이터로 조절하는 자유 계수가 없다는 뜻이다. 원자 상수는 추적 가능한 독립 측정 문헌값을, 장치 파라미터는 해당 장치의 독립 측정값과 불확도를 사용한다.
allowed_inputs: Transition frequencies, dipoles/CG coefficients, decay branching, isotope composition, density/temperature profile, cell length, magnetic field와 independently characterized collision/transit rates
Δ, δ, pump/seed powers, waist convention, beam profiles/crossing angles, polarization과 collection geometry
별도로 측정한 post-cell optical transmission, detector QE/transfer, electronic background, pump/seed technical-noise PSD와 필요한 cross spectra; target squeezing trace에서 역산하지 않는다
forbidden_shortcuts: Squeezing efficiency, arbitrary excess-noise coefficient, fitted loss 또는 유사한 숨은 noise scale
목표 gain이나 squeezing에 맞춘 residual coupling, mode-overlap/polarization/Zeeman participation penalty 또는 dephasing rate
현재의 inherited 0.74 residual, v7 gain-fit ell 또는 output-constrained Gaussian fit을 microscopic 입력으로 승격하는 것
M(Ω)의 commutator defect만으로 최소 vacuum noise를 선택한 뒤 이를 atomic D(Ω)로 부르는 것
셀 내부 absorption을 post-cell loss로 다시 적용하거나 임의 power cap으로 self-consistent depletion을 대체하는 것
Δ/δ scan을 RF noise spectrum으로 바꾸어 표기하거나 −7.8 dB 한 점의 일치를 전체 spectrum 검증으로 간주하는 것
no_fit_contract.unknown_input_policy: 독립 입력이 없으면 필요한 측정과 그 입력에 대한 conditional sensitivity/uncertainty를 명시한다. 최적화로 숨기거나 missing 값을 편리한 상수로 채우지 않는다. Fitted exploratory 결과는 별도 진단이며 Grand Challenge의 no-fit 통과로 세지 않는다.
no_fit_contract.calibration_vs_holdout: '한 operating point에 맞춘 뒤'는 독립 계측으로 장치 입력·단위·정규화를 확정하고 기준점 예측을 대조한다는 뜻이다. 기준점의 gain/S₋(Ω)을 목적함수로 물리 계수를 맞추는 것은 금지한다. 이후 다른 Δ, δ, T, P_pump 조건에서는 제어량과 독립 측정으로 확인된 입력 변화만 반영하고 모델 계수는 재조정하지 않는다.

reference_operating_point.source: README.md의 Sim et al. Sci. Rep. 15, 7727 (2025) reference와 fwm-reference-parameter-provenance
reference_operating_point.comparison_targets: Nominal gain ≈15와 보고된 intensity-difference squeezing −7.8 dB 및 해당 측정 조건의 전체 RF spectrum. Gain 정의, 분석 주파수, SQL, 전자잡음 보정 여부와 불확도를 source-specific하게 확정한다.
reference_operating_point.provenance_boundary: 이 값들은 저장소의 문헌 reference defaults이며 현재 장치의 새 독립 측정을 의미하지 않는다. 특히 legacy detection efficiency는 재확인이 필요한 입력이다. Rounded output-power ratios와 nominal gain을 동일 정밀도의 한 데이터 행으로 합치지 않는다. −7.8 dB는 fitting anchor가 아니라 비교 대상이다.

milestones.title: 1. Reduced four-level theorem/model
acceptance_criteria: 유도에 사용할 atomic generator의 trace/Hermiticity/GKSL 조건과 각 reservoir의 명시적 provenance를 먼저 검증한다. Nonzero legacy coherence-only dephasing 및 추적되지 않은 superoperator 수정을 총 generator의 CP 통과만으로 승인하지 않는다.
현재 GABES double-Λ Hamiltonian, collapse operators, state normalization과 field/collective-atom normalization을 명시한다. 정리의 가정·적용 범위·선형화 오차를 적고 pump-only weak-seed 또는 finite-seed Floquet 기준 상태를 구분한다.

같은 pumped Lindbladian으로부터 drift M(Ω)와 microscopic D(Ω)를 각각 유도한다. Atomic operator Einstein relation 또는 동등한 microscopic reservoir derivation에서 시작해 spontaneous decay, dephasing, transit/reset 및 채택한 collision channels의 noise와 cross correlations를 추적한다. M만으로 D를 추정하지 않는다.
Atomic Markov diffusion과 원자 자유도 제거 후 frequency-dependent effective field diffusion을 구분한다. Operator ordering, Fourier sign, photon flux, Ω=2πf, Nambu/companion blocks와 reservoir commutator를 고정한다.

Local/global commutator preservation, generated-noise covariance의 Hermiticity/positivity와 total covariance의 quantum uncertainty를 자동 검증한다. ±Ω sidebands를 함께 유지하고, uncertainty 검사는 명시한 quadrature/physical temporal-mode convention에서 수행한다. Residual과 최소 고유값을 저장하며 임의 PSD clipping으로 실패를 가리지 않는다.
유도와 별도로 atomic Liouvillian/quantum-regression 또는 직접 reservoir-correlation reference를 구현해 응답과 noise를 대조한다. No-atom, zero-length, passive-loss, ideal-amplifier limits와 weak-seed reference parity를 검사한다.
Hot-vapor/non-collinear 확장에서 독립 velocity classes의 noise covariance를 올바른 density/volume weight로 합산한다. 평균 noise amplitude를 제곱하지 않으며 collision으로 class correlations가 생기는 경우 독립성을 재검토한다.
Floquet order, velocity quadrature/cutoff, RF grid와 propagation resolution의 독립 수렴을 보고한다. 내부 불변량 PASS는 유도한 모델의 일관성 검사이며 실험적 완전성의 증명으로 사용하지 않는다.
deliverables: 가정과 정규화가 명시된 reduced-model derivation/theorem 및 machine-readable drift/diffusion contract
독립 microscopic reference, 자동 invariant/limit/convergence 검증과 재현 가능한 실패 사례

milestones.title: 2. No-fit prediction
milestones.activation_trigger: Milestone 1의 검증된 reduced core와 독립 입력 ledger가 준비되면 실행한다. 누락된 실측 입력은 conditional prediction으로 명시하고 실험 검증 상태를 별도로 유지한다.
acceptance_criteria: 하나의 입력 ledger와 동일한 pumped state/propagation에서 probe/conjugate powers와 명시된 두 gain, source covariance, detected S₋(Ω)을 동시에 계산한다. 모든 입력에 source, units, uncertainty, measurement date/applicability를 연결한다.

S₋(Ω)=PSD[i_probe−g i_conjugate]/PSD_SQL을 명시한 동일 mean photocurrents, detector transfer와 balancing weight g에 대해 정의한다. Linear SQL-normalized ratio, 10 log10 S₋ 및 calibrated absolute PSD를 구분해 출력한다. g는 실측/사전 선언한 readout 조건이고 spectrum에 맞추는 숨은 계수가 아니다.
최소 기존 0.1–4 MHz reference band를 다루고 실제 측정 전체 대역으로 확장한다. Source spectrum과 detector/technical-noise contributions, RBW/VBW/averaging 및 electronics subtraction convention을 분리해 동일 측정량끼리 비교한다.
입력 불확도와 수치 오차를 전파한 prediction interval을 gain과 RF spectrum 모두에 제공한다. 필요한 seed linearization, transport 또는 Markov approximation이 깨지는 영역은 출력의 적용 범위에서 표시한다.
No-fit contract를 기계적으로 감사한다. Reference point의 불일치는 결과로 보존하고 원인 후보를 제시하며 efficiency/loss/noise/coupling scale을 최적화해 제거하지 않는다.
deliverables: 입력 provenance/uncertainty ledger와 하나의 명령으로 재현하는 absolute gain + S₋(Ω) prediction bundle
Reference point 비교, source/detector/noise budget과 approximation/error report

milestones.title: 3. Out-of-sample test
blocked_on: 여러 Δ, δ, T, P_pump에서 gain/powers와 전체 RF squeezing spectrum을 함께 기록한 raw dataset 및 independently measured apparatus inputs
조건별 SQL/dark/transfer traces, RF settings, uncertainty와 모델 조정에 사용하지 않은 검증 조건
milestones.unblock_condition: Provenance와 uncertainty가 있는 dataset을 확보하고, 모델 선택/진단에 쓴 조건과 untouched holdout 조건 및 사전 평가 지표를 고정한다. 예측 실행에는 milestone 2가 필요하다.
acceptance_criteria: Operating conditions 전체를 기준으로 split하여 같은 trace의 RF bins가 양쪽으로 새지 않게 한다. Δ, δ, T, P_pump 각각의 변화와 가능한 joint variations를 포함하고 검증 도메인을 선언한다.
모델·입력 추정 절차·평가 지표·허용 오차를 holdout 열람 전에 고정한다. 다른 조건의 gain과 전체 S₋(Ω)을 no-refit으로 예측하고 평균 잔차, spectral shape, 최저 noise와 사전 정의한 bandwidth에 대해 실측 불확도와 함께 평가한다.
실패하면 detuning/frequency/temperature/power에 따른 residual structure로 누락 physics 또는 잘못된 가정을 식별한다. 실패를 계수 보정으로 덮지 않는다. 이미 본 holdout은 이후 model-development data로 표시하고 개선 모델은 새로운 untouched data로 다시 검증한다.
공개된 −7.8 dB 한 점은 이미 알려진 reference이므로 blind holdout으로 부르지 않는다. 기준점 일치와 조건을 바꾼 예측 성공을 독립 관문으로 남긴다.
deliverables: 동결된 split/metrics manifest, gain과 spectrum의 joint holdout report 및 failure residual map
실패별 missing-physics 가설과 이를 구분할 후속 측정/계산 계획

milestones.title: 4. Full atom 및 physics ablation
milestones.activation_trigger: Reduced-model 유도와 예측 경로가 검증되고 적용 범위/잔차가 기록되면 확장한다. 수치 ablation은 실험 자료와 병행할 수 있지만 −7.8 dB의 원인에 대한 최종 주장은 held-out 검증을 요구한다.
acceptance_criteria: Full ⁸⁵Rb D1 hyperfine/Zeeman, independently characterized collision/transit physics, transverse modes/collection, segmentwise pump depletion을 한 요소씩 추가한다. 각 variant에서 drift와 diffusion을 같은 microscopic model로 함께 갱신한다.
Explicit Zeeman CG paths는 averaged line strengths/participation penalties를 대체하고 population을 한 번만 센다. Collision model에는 상응하는 fluctuation channels와 velocity/spin correlations를 포함한다.

각 z segment에서 pump/probe/conjugate mean fields와 atomic state를 self-consistently 다시 풀고 local M,D를 재계산한다. Distributed absorption/reservoir energy와 pair-conversion energy accounting을 분리해 기록하고 step/iteration/mode convergence를 검증한다.
Add-one ablation과 full-model leave-one-out ablation을 수행한다. 중요한 physics 간 상호작용도 조사해 비가산적인 dB 변화를 단순 합으로 해석하지 않는다. 각 variant의 measured inputs를 고정하고 보상 계수를 refit하지 않는다.
Gain, 전체 S₋(Ω), bandwidth와 검증 잔차의 변화를 uncertainty 및 runtime과 함께 비교한다. 어떤 physics가 실제 관측된 −7.8 dB와 spectral shape를 결정하는지 정량화하고 unresolved contribution은 남긴다.

−7.8 dB를 재현한 단일 숫자, gain-only approximation, fitted Gaussian covariance 또는 내부 commutator/positivity PASS만으로 done 처리하지 않는다.
독립 입력만으로 gain과 RF spectrum이 사전 선언한 실험 불확도/평가 기준 안에서 함께 검증되어야 한다. 실패 원인 규명이나 no-go 결과는 유효한 연구 산출물이지만 원래의 예측 목표 달성과는 구분한다.
Code/config/data hashes, raw 또는 접근 가능한 검증 데이터, derivation, reproduction commands, numerical tolerances와 적용 범위를 보존하고 python -m pytest -q를 통과한 구현을 전달한다.
